text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review paper focused on modeling nitrogen exports to reduce coastal hypoxia. While it uses land use data and scenarios, the primary research objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. The core focus is on evaluating nitrogen input reduction strategies under climate scenarios. The LULC is an input variable held constant after 2005, and the model does not simulate future LULC change. The paper fails the core inclusion criterion of having LULC prediction/simulation as its primary focus. It also does not implement ≥2 future LULC scenarios for comparison.)
